_roles: distractor: a competing record, its facts in the answer mean confusion; lure: text on the topic or with the words of the question but without an answer; noise: a striking fact unrelated to the question; value: a part of the right answer, its facts are in answer_key; evidence: a second step the answer needs, it holds the answer
_fields: distance: tokens between the insert and the needle; side: where the insert stands relative to the needle; depth_range: needle depth in percent, overrides the depths of the run; question_position: before or after the text

porto.text: Every visitor to the Porto Tram Museum is asked to pull the iron lever at the gate and stamp the entry card with a red seal.

madrid.text: Every visitor to the Madrid Railway Museum is asked to wind the old clock in the hall and leave a coin in the wooden box.

vienna.text: Every visitor to the Vienna Transport Museum is asked to press the copper button by the stairs and write a wish on a paper ticket.
